verdict.rationale: Copilot cloud agent is documented to work independently in the background on assigned tasks. Copilot also documents fully isolated cloud sandbox environments, plus a central page to track agent sessions and the ability to steer work via @copilot on pull requests. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cloud-agent background execution, and explicit evidence about task duration limits for longer-running work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment

citations.quote: With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.

Cloud and local sandboxes provide isolated execution environments that let Copilot safely interact with code, tools, filesystem, and network resources securely on your local machine or in fully isolated cloud environments.
Use one centralized control page to jump between agent sessions, check progress, and stay in control without losing your place.
